allytips: Use Wilding Claw to gain attack speed and bonus damage for your next two attacks, making it effective in close combat.
Recast Iron Mantle to get a larger shield and healing over time, which is great for soaking up damage and regenerating health.
Blazing Stampede's stun can disrupt enemy movements; recasting it gives you immunity to immobilizing effects, allowing you to escape or chase down enemies.
enemytips: Avoid attacking Udyr immediately after he uses Wilding Claw to prevent bonus damage from his next two attacks.
Stay out of range of Iron Mantle's shield and healing effect to minimize the amount of damage you take and health you lose.
Try to immobilize Udyr during or right after using Blazing Stampede to break his stun immunity and slow him down.
